notes.title: Demo patch #2
notes.content:
[b]Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft under your steps![/b]

Here's the second demo patch, focused on fixing bugs. It also contains some gameplay tweaks.

I'm now working on the next demo update with two main goals:

- Improving the discovery system to enhance the overall experience
- Adding more content, including items, furnishings, structures, and more

Thank you for your patience!

[h1]Demo Version 0.2.0[/h1]

[h2]Added:[/h2]

- [b]Added[/b]: New room system. Any enclosed area will now be considered as a room, and the rest as outside.
- [b]Added[/b]: Keyboard bindings for changing game speed.
- [b]Added[/b]: Alerts when greenfeet have no jobs.
- [b]Added[/b]: Helper text about jobs in the preview panel of a jobless greenfeet.
- [b]Added[/b]: Linux support, but official Steam builds are not yet available.


[h2]Changes:[/h2]

- [b]Changed[/b]: Sub-tasks icons will no longer be displayed to avoid them stacking with their parent task.
- [b]Changed[/b]: Prevented camera to move outside of the map.
- [b]Changed[/b]: Savegames are now located inside the cache folder instead of document folder.
- [b]Changed[/b]: Items no longer spread to adjacent tiles, they spread visually within the tile they were spawned on.
- [b]Changed[/b]: New AI algorithm for job, tool and activity lookup.
- [b]Changed[/b]: Improved rendering performances with a 90% reduction of displayed sprites.
- [b]Changed[/b]: New save format enabling migration support.
- [b]Changed[/b]: Greenfeet will now stop working exactly when the workshift is over instead of finishing their current task.
- [b]Changed[/b]: Added a preemption system for tasks: greenfeet will now lock a building job if they take care of bringing the items.
- [b]Changed[/b]: All furnishings are now crossable.

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

- [b]Fixed[/b]: Culled items not being haulable.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Items changing of variant sprite when being culled.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Invisible hauled items when grabbed offscreen.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Interrupted haul jobs not relocated to the item's new position.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Blinking plant textures when changing season.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Deleted zone not clearing inhabitants.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Plant bounce not working when loading a save.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Stumps not being removed if preventing a task to be completed.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Items not being moved out from cut plants when building above them.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Cut button not being toggled on trees in some cases.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Greenfeet stuck if trying to perform a job they are already standing upon.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Doors and some walls being considered as part of a room.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Not eating at a table if the meal is above a chair.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Furniture "facing" property not updated after loading a save.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Crash during game unloading to main menu.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Crash when revealing a sector with lone greenfeet and having removed the default laborer job.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Visual glitches in the UI when using Windows' display scaling setting.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Orphan jobs cases when items/furnitures are removed.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Added check at startup to verify the save folder is not writable.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Workers staying assigned to deleted zones.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Orphaned haul jobs staying active.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Batch of english typos.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Hauling jobs being issued for items that are attached to a crafting or building job.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Dropped items blinking randomly.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Missing ground, wall and roof textures on some older driver or integrated GPUs.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Green checkmark not going away in the discovery bench when obtaining new materials.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Unconsistent activity score sorting leading to starving greenfeet.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Opening the menu using the UI not pausing the game.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Map dragging interrupted when crossing UI parts.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Special chars crashing when used in a save file name.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Invalid move out and hauling jobs causing stuck greenfeet.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Performance issue when spawning dead leaves during the storm season.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Performance issue when cleaning dead leaves during the cold season.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Pathfinding failures when crossing enclosed spaces with a mix of zones.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Greenfeet working for an hour too long.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Wrong storage zone displayed when editing a zone-based craft order.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Move out tasks not performed if using custom zone jobs.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Greenfeet having incompatible traits like Lazy + Hard worker.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Exhausted greenfeet waking up right away.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Invisible greenfeet when returning from exploration.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Being able to build on water.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Collapsing roofs overriding water with dirt.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: "Forever" settings on crafting zones not working.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Missing tool notification blinking when tools are picked up by greenfeet.

notes.title: Greenfeet Haven Dev Report - Happy new year 2025!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft under your steps![/b]

Here's the development progress for the past month. This is a synthesis of [url=https://owlycode-makes-games.com/blog]my weekly blog posts[/url].

[h1]Fuel System[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/52144d28bd325968e3d78b3d89b5f5df1225ab39.gif[/img]

Campfires now consume items tagged as "flammable." Of course, some items are more desirable than others. Generally, you'd prefer to burn a log, but in desperate times, why not burn a wooden plank or even a wooden statue?

[h1]Auto Tools[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/13c7c65c48d5944caafc23ee95e0d2e22bb66368.gif[/img]

Thanks to playtest feedback, it became clear that the tool system was too complex to use. Manually managing equipment required too much micro-management and was hard for new players to grasp. What's more frustrating than a tree left uncut while the axe is lying right next to it?

Now, the Greenfeet will automatically equip themselves with the best tools for the tasks at hand. You can still specialize workers by setting restrictions: for instance, preventing a lumberjack from using a pickaxe.

[h1]User Experience and Readability[/h1]

To make the game more readable and accessible, many small improvements have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/a234007eef716574a767a2eaf2119fa97592236a.png[/img]

For example, the menu has been redesigned to be more hierarchical and organized.

The "Cut" and "Harvest" commands have been merged into a single "Gather" command to avoid accidentally destroying plants. Cutting down a bush instead of simply picking its berries happened way too often.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/b5c5c401351c332828ef55d3a461a53032978137.png[/img]

A new job evaluator has been implemented to clearly explain why a task cannot be completed by any Greenfeet. For example, it might be due to the lack of a necessary tool or the task being unreachable.

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]

I'm now fully focused on producing a public demo for the game. The deadline has been set to mid-february for a demo candidate, and it should be publicly available in march.  [b]You can already gain access to the game in its current alpha state[/b]: simply join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/NydNQJyV98]Discord server[/url] and follow the instructions there.

Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to wishlist [i]Greenfeet Haven[/i] on Steam!

notes.title: Greenfeet Haven Dev Report - November 2024
notes.content:
[b]Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft under your steps![/b]

Here's the development progress for this month. This is a synthesis of [url=https://owlycode-makes-games.com/blog]my weekly blog posts[/url].

It’s been a few weeks since I managed to release the closed alpha version. I’ve received a lot of feedback: written, recorded, and through the in-game feedback system. Thank you all once more! It has taught me a lot about both the current weak points and the strong points of the game.

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/969dd131fbe36ee00f0db267e283ce9f6542eb13.png[/img]

The game now features a skippable tutorial. It helps you understand the basics and will occasionally trigger to provide more context on advanced topics. It’s been designed to be as brief as possible, so you won’t spend 30 minutes reading to understand what’s going on.

[h1]Improved Exploration[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/6f0a36afa8bef1d7d84c900136346557ca1c590c.png[/img]

The exploration mechanic has undergone another iteration, bringing significant gameplay and aesthetic changes. The fog of war has been redesigned to let you see a little through it, helping you decide which area to explore first. Exploration time now depends on modifiers and the number of explorers you send out. Most importantly, it will now require food, based on the number of explorers and the time they’ll be away.

[h1]Improved AI[/h1]

I revisited the AI of the Greenfeet to add new behaviors, making their actions feel more natural. Not working on this part for several weeks gave me perspective and allowed me to solve many design issues that were hurting performance or causing bugs. Now, the Greenfeet will seek shelter inside buildings if their need for shelter gets too low. They’ll also tend to sleep at night as much as possible and take short naps during the day if they’re tired.

[h1]Graphical Boost[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/e32121155f22da03c8c49fa4b21316d6ce29fccf.png[/img]

Making the game look good has been a focus for me lately, and I’ve secured time to work on this aspect. As shown above, the fog of war got an upgrade, as did the world generation! There are now more terrain variations and fewer uniform terrains.

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]

I’m still working hard on weekly updates for the alpha build. [b]You can gain access anytime[/b]—simply join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/NydNQJyV98]Discord server[/url] and follow the instructions there.

Stay tuned for more updates, and don’t forget to wishlist [i]Greenfeet Haven[/i] on Steam!

notes.title: Greenfeet Haven Dev Report - October 2024
notes.content:
[b]Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft under your steps![/b]

It's been a month since the last progress report. Much has been accomplished since then!

[h1]Exploration[/h1]

The map is now hidden at first. You will have to send greenfeet out on exploration missions to reveal more and more of it. Each explored zone will yield its own surprises: new biomes, new resources, encounters... The system is now working and only requires more content to be added in the coming weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/952cebc3664bf56e179194e5a7b085b1c8e29112.png[/img]

[h1]Feedback and visual improvements[/h1]

Great efforts were put into the visual aspect of the game to make it feel more credible, alive, and dynamic.

Discovering a new item now produces a visual notification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/a7fb90918dd86b98dfff4f992ee0157e3a72b410.png[/img]

Greenfeet moving through plants will make them bounce.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/dfd0e289685568e5fb6873a99b4c06dbc1c67028.gif[/img]

Greenfeet will now get close to items they are interacting with, thanks to the new "intra-tile" movement system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/08fe5c0eac0067f567abe027524898d1a7ad1a06.gif[/img]

[h1]Early game content[/h1]

The first technological tier of the game is playable and will be present in the alpha build. This is the phase of the game where your greenfeet slowly move from bare survival to having a small settlement with their basic needs addressed. I won't expand too much on the content, as it is one key feature of the game to discover things by yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/3e8e74d317626d045b5837c074582484a65ee320.png[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

I've finally started fixing all the bug reports that have accumulated over the past few weeks.

    [b]FIXED:[/b] The first right-click was not being registered.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] Discovery icons no longer stack in an unreadable way.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] Stumps are now automatically cut by the forestry area.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] A regression that prevented plant growth has been resolved.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] The sleep icon for a Greenfeet sometimes remained active after waking up.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] Greenfeet tended to move endlessly to avoid stacking.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] Transport tasks could not be canceled.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] Clicking on the inventory zone selector caused the game to crash.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] Greenfeet appeared misaligned on their beds.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] It was possible to stack multiple sowing tasks on the same tile.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] Greenfeet prioritized sleeping on the ground too often, even with an available bed.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] Some items were never transported to an available storage element.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] It was possible to create zones and place jobs in an unexplored area.
    [b]FIXED:[/b] Sometimes drop spots would disappear if they were filled.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

I'm still working hard to produce an alpha build by the end of October. To get access when it is ready, simply [url=https://discord.gg/NydNQJyV98]join the Discord server[/url] and follow the instructions there.

Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to wishlist Greenfeet Haven on Steam!

notes.title: Greenfeet Haven Monthly Dev Report
notes.content:
[b]Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft under your steps![/b]

Autumn is looming here in France, and after some holidays in August, I've been back at work on the game full-speed for the past two weeks. Big changes have come to Greenfeet Haven, and more are on the way!

[h2]New crafting system[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/25eaacaeec0c480d47a2540bf6a81146d4518d13.png[/img]

First, I've revamped the crafting system, ditching the old "discovery" mechanic for a more dynamic and experimental approach. Now, every workshop offers unique actions, and players can combine items or apply actions to them to see what happens. For instance, what would you get if you combined a sharp stone with a branch? What would happen if you apply the "crush" action to wheat seeds? The sense of discovery is more natural and rewarding.

You can read more about this on the dev blog: [url=https://owlycode-makes-games.com/blog/weekly-progress-32]Weekly Progress #32[/url]

[h2]Improved pathfinding and proximity checking[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857005/e57c67d9cadbc103cd3a124e81bae0057f10b8c5.png[/img]

On a more technical note, I've finally tackled the issue of building a better pathfinding system. This paves the way for more elaborate features like social interactions. Greenfeet can now detect where the best place is to go if they feel lonely, want comfort, or need a quiet place.

You can also get more details about this on the blog: [url=https://owlycode-makes-games.com/blog/weekly-progress-33]Weekly Progress #33[/url]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

This foundation is a big step forward. I'm now focusing on improving the game's content, from the art to the overall gameplay feel. The next major milestone is the start of [b]a closed alpha preview[/b] where you can experience the game and share your thoughts! To get access, simply join [url=https://discord.gg/NydNQJyV98]the Discord server[/url] and follow the instructions there.

Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to wishlist Greenfeet Haven on Steam!
